rationale.zh: 本次提交修改 deflate 流的重置契约：gzip 头指针 s->gzhead 不再只在 deflateInit2_() 里清空，而是在每次 deflateResetKeep()（deflateReset 的核心）中清空，使 deflateReset() 真正兑现文档“重置一切状态（含头）”的承诺；提交说明还提醒“依赖头部在 reset 后仍保留的代码可能会被破坏”。这正是会让依赖旧复用语义的调用方失配的状态契约变化。harness 每个输入都经 deflateInit() 进入 deflateReset()，改动行在固定语料回放中被执行；但它从不调用 deflateSetHeader()，也不依赖 reset 后的头部残留，编译通过、回放无新崩溃，harness 无需修改，属于显式 state 阴性。
rationale.en: This commit changes the reset contract of a deflate stream: the gzip header pointer s->gzhead is no longer cleared only in deflateInit2_() but in every deflateResetKeep() (the core of deflateReset), so deflateReset() now honours the documented promise to reset all state including the header; the commit message warns that code relying on the header persisting across resets may break. That is exactly the kind of state-contract change that breaks callers relying on the old reuse semantics. The harness enters deflateReset() through deflateInit() on every input, so the changed line runs on fixed-corpus replay; but it never calls deflateSetHeader() and does not depend on a header surviving a reset: it builds, replay shows no new crash, and no harness change is needed - an explicit state negative.

blockers.detail: nghttp2_session_server_new(&session, callbacks, nullptr): no nghttp2_option, so the built-in receive extension NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE is never enabled and every PRIORITY_UPDATE frame (type 0x10) is ignored at session.c:6354

evidence: M (PR #1729, RFC 9218 PRIORITY_UPDATE) adds the frame type 0x10 with its own payload format (nghttp2_frame_unpack_priority_update_payload) and makes it processable only behind nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) plus a local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1; fuzz/fuzz_target.cc is unchanged (last changed 2017)

partial fixes: enabling only the extension option leaves the frame dropped at session.c:6383 (unpack/processing lines stay 0); sending only the setting leaves it dropped at session.c:6354 (all frame-path lines stay 0)

with the counterfactual fix the budgeted fuzzing quickly reaches a library assertion in nghttp2_session_mem_recv (nghttp2_session.c:6845, `iframe->state == NGHTTP2_IB_IGN_ALL`) on the newly reachable path - code the original harness could never exercise

rationale.zh: 本次合并（PR #1729）实现 RFC 9218 的 PRIORITY_UPDATE 帧：新增帧类型 0x10 及其载荷格式（input_format：服务器端新接受的一种帧格式），但只有在两项配置同时满足时才处理——会话选项 nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) 打开内建扩展，且本端 SETTINGS 中声明 NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1（configuration）。harness 自 2017 年起用 nghttp2_session_server_new(..., nullptr) 建会话、只提交 MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS 一项设置，因此任何 0x10 帧都在 session.c:6354 被忽略；只开选项不发设置又会在 6383 行被忽略。新帧格式的解包、处理与优先级更新代码覆盖恒为 0，harness 照常运行。两个维度缺一不可：新格式本身需要新配置才可达，正是分布设计中“新格式分支需要新 flag 才可达”的隐式 mix。反事实修复 Δh（约 16 行，只改 harness）打开选项并按输入奇偶决定是否发送该设置；打开后定额 fuzz 很快在新路径上触发库内断言（session.c:6845），说明这段从未被 fuzz 过的代码确有问题。M^1 不存在该帧类型，缺口由本次引入。
rationale.en: This merge (PR #1729) implements the RFC 9218 PRIORITY_UPDATE frame: a new frame type 0x10 with its own payload format (input_format: a frame format the server now accepts), processed only when two configuration conditions hold - the session option nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) enables the built-in extension and the local SETTINGS announce NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 (configuration). Since 2017 the harness creates the session with nghttp2_session_server_new(..., nullptr) and submits only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, so every 0x10 frame is ignored at session.c:6354; enabling only the option still drops it at line 6383. The unpacking, processing and priority-update code of the new frame format keeps zero coverage while the harness runs normally. Both dimensions are needed: the new format is reachable only through the new configuration - the 'new format branch that needs a new flag' silent mix of the distribution design. The counterfactual fix (about 16 lines, harness only) enables the option and sends the setting for odd-sized inputs; with it, budgeted fuzzing soon trips a library assertion on the new path (session.c:6845), showing that this never-fuzzed code does have problems. The frame type does not exist at M^1, so the gap is introduced by this change.

rationale.zh: 本次提交改变了输入编码中非有限浮点数的解码方式：此前 CBOR / MessagePack 输入里的 NaN、Inf 在构造值时一律被替换成 null；本次起按原样保存为 NaN/Inf（仅在 dump() 输出时写成 null）。CBOR harness 的往返检查写的是 assert(j1 == j2)：同一份输入解码出的值，经 to_cbor 再 from_cbor 后要求相等。现在任何带 NaN 编码的输入（如 3 字节的半精度 NaN F9 7E 00）都会解码出 NaN，而 NaN != NaN，harness 自己的断言立即 abort，栈顶就在 harness 的 LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput（fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp:45）；同一输入在 M^1 上解码为 null，断言通过。M^1 不失败，失败由本次引入，属于显式 input_format 阳性（输入编码的解码语义变化触发 harness 侧断言）。维护者两天后在 b026591e 把断言改为比较再次序列化的结果。注：该变化也可看作 basic_json 值语义（api）的变化；这里按“输入中 NaN 编码的解码方式变化”归为 input_format。
rationale.en: This commit changes how non-finite floating-point values in the input encodings are decoded: before it, a NaN or Inf in CBOR / MessagePack input was replaced by null when the value was built; from now on it is kept as NaN/Inf (and written as null only by dump()). The CBOR harness checks its round trip with assert(j1 == j2): the value decoded from the input must equal the value decoded again after to_cbor. Now every input carrying a NaN encoding (e.g. the 3-byte half-precision NaN F9 7E 00) decodes to NaN, and since NaN != NaN the harness's own assertion aborts at once, in the harness's LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp:45); at M^1 the same input decodes to null and the assertion holds. No failure at M^1, so it is introduced by this change: an explicit input_format positive (a change in how an input encoding is decoded trips a harness-side assertion). The maintainers changed the assertion two days later (b026591e) to compare the re-serialized bytes. Note: the change can also be read as a change of basic_json value semantics (api); it is classified here as input_format because what changed is how a NaN encoding in the input is decoded.

rationale.zh: M 统一进程启动顺序：BaseInit() 不再调用 InitCommunication()/CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores()，要求先建共享内存、InitProcess() 再 BaseInit()。H0 的 FuzzerInitialize 仍按旧顺序 BaseInit(); InitProcess();，共享内存从未创建，InitProcess 直接 PANIC 中止。S0 正常，本次引入。H 的提交标题直接引用 Postgres commit b406478b，把顺序改为 CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(); InitProcess(); BaseInit();。
rationale.en: M unifies the process startup order: BaseInit() no longer calls InitCommunication()/CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(), so callers must create shared memory and call InitProcess() before BaseInit(). FuzzerInitialize in the harness H0 still calls BaseInit(); InitProcess(); in the old order, shared memory is never created, and InitProcess() aborts with PANIC. The same harness works with S0 (M^1), so the degradation is introduced by this change. The title of the fix H cites Postgres commit b406478b; it changes the order to CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores(); InitProcess(); BaseInit();.

rationale.zh: fuzz_as 绕过 main()，自己按顺序组合调用 gas 的各个 init/begin 函数，依赖『read_begin 会建立 notes obstack』这一状态约定。M（gas: set up notes obstack earlier）把 obstack_begin(&notes) 从 read_begin 移到 main，harness 组合出的状态缺少 notes，首次分配段信息即跳到空函数指针 SEGV。S0 正常，故本次引入。H（oss-fuzz #9400，注明 upstream gas has changed / issue 48997）在 harness 中补上 obstack_begin(&notes) 等初始化。注：该例也可视为 lifecycle（初始化顺序）；按『组合调用依赖的状态约定』归为 state。
rationale.en: fuzz_as bypasses main() and calls the gas init/begin functions itself in a fixed order, relying on the state convention that read_begin() sets up the notes obstack. M (gas: set up notes obstack earlier) moves obstack_begin(&notes) from read_begin() into main(), so the state built by the harness has no notes obstack and the first section-info allocation jumps through a null function pointer (SEGV). The harness works with S0 (M^1), so the degradation is introduced by this change. H (oss-fuzz #9400, which cites "upstream gas has changed" and issue 48997) adds obstack_begin(&notes) and other initialisation to the harness. Note: the case could also be read as lifecycle (initialisation order); it is labelled state because it is about a state convention that the composed calls rely on.
